text:
marta_sales: Folks — Acme Global POC is stalled. Procurement & Legal surfaced three blockers: model escrow, EU data residency + FIPS KMS requirement, and an updated pilot pricing sheet. They want an exec escalation to unblock. Can we triage?

ryan_csm: On it. Quick Q — what "they" means timeline-wise? Do we have EOD or next-week?

marta_sales: They asked for answers by EOD Thursday. Procurement is pressuring their InfoSec lead.

nina_legal: Need specifics: 1) IP/weights escrow template (what we’re willing to deposit), 2) DPA amendment for EU residency + subprocessors, 3) SOC2 scope confirmation. Also clarify KMS: will Redwood accept customer-managed FIPS KMS or do we need to provide HSM-backed keys?

kevin_infra: Technical note — we can provision a Private VPC in eu-west-1 quickly. FIPS KMS support requires HSM integration; we have two options: a) use our KMS connector to let customer manage keys (1–2 day set up + sec review), or b) onboard HSM on our side (multi-week). Connector looks like the fastest path.

ton y_ops: I can draft the connector runbook and checklist. For escrow: we’ve done a precedent (Orbit) where we provided an escrow with weights + verification instructions. Legal would need to limit scope (weights only, no toolchain).

nina_legal: Agreed. I'll reuse the Orbit escrow template and prepare redlines: limit to model weights, exclude proprietary infra components, 12-month hold/release clause, and narrow usage rights. Will aim to circulate a draft by tomorrow morning.

marta_sales: Procurement also asked whether the pilot can be a flat fee rather than a committed spend. They proposed $40k for a 3-week pilot with optional rollout credits. They also want a pilot SLA. Thoughts?

alex_cro: I can take exec call. Proposed commercial counter: pilot fee $35k + $50k credit on an annual commitment signed within 90 days. Pilot SLA: 99.9% with standard region caveats. I’ll join a call Friday 08:00 PST. @kevin_infra @nina_legal please join so we can speak to infra + legal constraints.

kevin_infra: I’ll be on. Quick flag: if we book $50k as credit, finance wants it logged as marketing credit unless it's tied to revenue recognition triggers. Ops, can you confirm treatment?

ton y_ops: Confirmed — finance ok with marketing credit classification if legal signs off on redemption terms. We’ll need SOW template updated to reflect pilot-to-credit conversion.

security-bot: security-bot: automated risk scan for Acme Global — EU data residency increases risk profile to "medium"; controls required: enforce at-rest encryption, KMS audit logs, and subnet-level egress filtering.

marta_sales: Thanks. @nina_legal — ETA on escrow draft? @tony_ops — can you prep updated SOW + pilot config (region, instance sizes, monitoring)? I’ll schedule the exec call.

ryan_csm: I’ll prep a one-slide TL;DR for execs: blockers, proposed commercial, technical mitigation, and decision asks.

alex_cro: :thumbsup: Let's get this resolved on the call. Marta — send invite and agenda.

marta_sales: Invite sent for Fri 08:00 PST / 16:00 CET. Agenda: 1) Legal escrow/DPA redlines (nina), 2) Infra plan and KMS approach (kevin), 3) Commercial pilot offer & credit (alex), 4) Next steps/Rollout timeline.

ryan_csm: Got it. I’ll attach the Orbit escrow precedent and the proposed pilot financials to the calendar invite.

nina_legal: Draft escrow + DPA redlines uploaded to the invite (comments welcome).

kevin_infra: Shared a short checklist for KMS connector setup in the invite thread.

marta_sales: Thanks team — let’s aim to have final positions ready before the call.

alex_cro: I’ll prep opening remarks and commit to a decision framework on the call.

marta_sales: Closing the loop here. Will update thread after the call.
